build_maskformer_model: build a MaskFormer model from a detectron2 config for semantic segmentation
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass on batched inputs to get semantic or panoptic segmentation predictions
run_semantic_inference: run semantic inference on mask classification and mask prediction outputs to get per-pixel logits
run_panoptic_inference: run panoptic inference on mask classification and mask prediction outputs to get segment IDs and info
review_maskformer_criterion: review the MaskFormer class and its SetCriterion loss computation with HungarianMatcher bipartite matching
